On October 24–25, Expo Georgia will host Unlimited Summit 2026 — the region's largest summit dedicated to the work ecosystem, digital transformation, and corporate culture!




Unlimited is a space where businesses, top talent and job seekers, tech companies, and startups meet to discuss the challenges and practical experiences encountered on the path to AI adoption and digitalization.


Higgsfield, Microsoft, Meta, Google, n8n, Huawei, Rakuten, Monday.com, Zoho, Envato, and many others are among the international companies whose speakers and official partners will share their experiences through solo presentations and panel discussions at the summit.

What awaits you?

- Thousands of attendees and non-stop networking

AgileXchange Georgia 2026: Hands-On Agile

AgileXchange Tbilisi 2026: Hands-On Agile




📅️ Friday, October 30, 2026

🕙️ 10:00 to 18:00

📍️ Radisson Blu Iveria, Tbilisi, 1 Rose Revolution Square – Google Maps

🗣️ Working language of the event: English




📢️ Are you ready to AgileXChange again?

Continuing our mission to put Georgia on the global Agile map and strengthen our local Agile community, we are proud to host the 5th edition of the International Agile Summit. What started as an event planned in just two sprints back in July 2023 has since grown into a full-scale international summit.

This year's theme is Hands-On Agile, and for the first time AgileXchange runs as a single full day built around practice. Two waves of parallel workshops across 6 rooms, led by international trainers, sit alongside the keynote, stage talks and a discussion with Georgian leaders.




🎙️ Meet Our Speakers & Trainers:

- Patricia Soler Herrero – Executive Coach, Facilitator, Keynote Speaker and Workshop Trainer.

- Jose Casal – Business Agility Consultant and co-founder of Actineo Consulting, a Professional Scrum Trainer, Flight Levels Guide and Certified Trainer for Training from the BACK of the Room.

- Christophe Martinot – ICAgile Trainer and Management 3.0 Facilitator, author of SPIRAL UP®.

- Jon Ward – Enterprise Agility and AI Consultant, founder of Beneficial Consulting and a Certified Thought Leader with the Agile Business Consortium.

- Nino Gorgadze – Project Management and Digital Transformation Expert (PMP®, PMI-ACP®) with over 20 years in project and portfolio management.

- Vato Dolidze – Organization Designer, panelist at "Agility Beyond Tech".

- Levan Khomeriki – CEO of Tbilisi Medic, the first company in Georgia's medical ecosystem to adopt Agile ways of working; panelist at "Agility Beyond Tech".

- Tornike Chkhaidze – Managing Partner at Niadagi, panelist at "Agility Beyond Tech".

- Kety Zhvania-Tyson – Co-founder of Metaphora, international trainer and learning experience designer with 30+ years in experiential learning.

- Mariam Brodzeli – Commercial Tribe Lead at Adjarabet, part of Flutter CEE, where she leads cross functional teams working on applications, promotions and personalization. Her experience spans commercial strategy, CRM, customer engagement and product delivery, bringing product, design and engineering teams together around shared goals.

- Beka Ujmajuridze – Senior Product Owner at Flutter CEE, working on the core platforms and capabilities that power regulated iGaming products across multiple markets. His experience spans product strategy, platform transformation, KYC, compliance, safer gambling and large-scale migrations, with a strong focus on turning complex business and regulatory challenges into scalable product solutions. He is particularly interested in how technology, regulation and product thinking can come together to create better player experiences and stronger digital businesses.

- Nodar Jintcharadze – Agile Coach at TBC, co-speaker on "How to Measure Anything Without Ruining Everything".

- David Mikaberidze – Agile Coach at TBC (PMP, MBA), co-speaker on "How to Measure Anything Without Ruining Everything".



🗓️ Full agenda: https://www.agilexchange.org/agenda



Alongside these experts, AgileXchange Vol. 5 will feature additional regional voices and community leaders from across industries.

🎤️ General Admission – 120 GEL

📍️ October 30, Radisson Blu Iveria

Full-day access to all keynotes, talks, panels and workshops.

Work directly with global Agile trainers in small-room, hands-on sessions

Ask your questions to international experts

Join panels and discussions with local leaders

Expand your network with Agile professionals

Be part of Georgia's growing international Agile community

Interested in partnering or sponsoring? Write to us on WhatsApp: +995 577 288557




🔗️ For more details, visit our website – agilexchange.org

📲️ Stay in the loop:

🔗️ AgileXchange on Facebook

🔗️ AgileXchange on LinkedIn




🌟️ Past Highlights:

AgileXchange Vol. 1 – Georgia's first-ever Agile Summit, July 2023

AgileXchange Vol. 2 – Featuring Agile Manifesto co-author Dr. Alistair Cockburn, October 2023

AgileXchange Vol. 3 – Full-scale summit with 400+ attendees, April 2024

AgileXchange Vol. 4 – Beyond the Frameworks, September 2025, Pullman Tbilisi




Are you attending the AgileXchange Volume 5 Anniversary Summit on October 30? Then let your friends know too: https://canva.link/s5shc2s57o8b28e




🎓 Special Offer: Trainings with Our Speakers

While in Tbilisi, our speakers will run additional trainings at an exclusive AgileXchange price!


Jose Casal · 2-day in-house trainings for companies

• Business Agility with Flight Levels (FLPro): $3,500 for the whole group (normally $15,000)

• Flow Metrics & Forecasting (PAM): $3,500 for the whole group (normally $12,000)

The price covers the whole group of 8-12 participants.


Jon Ward · AI-Enabled Business Transformation, 1-day workshop, up to 12 participants

• $300 per person (normally $800)


Details: https://www.agilexchange.org/#trainings

To book, contact us: agilexchangegeo@gmail.com or WhatsApp +995 577 288 557

DGFI 2026 | Digital Finance Conference

Where capital meets opportunity.




DGFI 2026 is a two-day international conference, now in its fifth year, that brings together financial institutions, regulators, technology companies, investors, and decision-makers from the Caucasus, Central Asia, and other international markets around digital finance.




Digital finance is entering a new stage. Stablecoins, tokenized assets, modern payment systems, and digital financial infrastructure are gradually moving beyond experimentation and becoming an integral part of global financial markets.




Alongside these developments, public and private sector leaders are shaping new regulatory frameworks, exploring modern models of capital movement, and building the infrastructure on which the next chapter of the financial system will be developed.




DGFI 2026 creates a platform for sharing practical experience, examining real world use cases, and building the strategic partnerships that will shape the financial future of the region.




The conference connects policy, technology, and capital while strengthening Georgia’s role as a regional meeting point for digital finance between the Caucasus and Central Asia.




Who Will Be in the Audience

• Central banks, regulators, and public sector representatives

• Banks, payment networks, and financial institutions

• Fintech, blockchain, and digital asset companies

• Investment funds, investors, and capital market participants

• Technology and financial infrastructure providers

• Founders, business leaders, and decision-makers

• Legal, compliance, and advisory firms




What to Expect

DGFI 2026 will feature a two-day international programme bringing together:

• Keynote presentations from international speakers

• Fireside discussions with regulators, financial institutions, and industry leaders

• Panel sessions covering regulation, payments, stablecoins, tokenization, and financial infrastructure

• Discussions on capital, investment, and regional market opportunities

• High-level networking and strategic meetings




The format is focused on practical knowledge, institutional dialogue, and the development of meaningful business relationships between the people and organizations directly shaping the future of finance.




About The Host

DGFI Conference is a regional digital finance platform connecting financial institutions, regulators, technology companies, investors, and innovators.




Through institutional events and international conferences, DGFI creates an environment where financial policy, modern technology, and capital come together around real opportunities.

Industry Talks 1.0 | Retail Transformation

Industry Talks is a large-scale B2B platform jointly presented by BDO Digital and BMG, designed to unite business leaders, top executives, and leading industry experts for high-impact strategic dialogue. This is an exclusive space where global visions and local practices converge to unlock entirely new avenues for business growth. Driven by an innovative, cyclical concept, the project's debut event, Industry Talks 1.0 | Retail Transformation, will be fully dedicated to the retail sector, paving the way for future editions covering other leading industries.


On November 6, 2026, at Pullman Tbilisi Axis Towers, key decision-makers from the retail and tech sectors will convene to discuss the digital transformation of modern business. The agenda dives deep into critical operational shifts, including large-scale process automation, the technological optimization of daily workflows, and data-driven strategic decision-making. Special emphasis will be placed on real-world case studies and the actionable insights of companies that have already successfully mastered the complex journey of digital transformation. All content is delivered in a highly engaging, business-first format tailored for immediate application.


This event is meticulously curated for company founders, C-level management, retail and tech executives, and professionals leading the digital evolution. Industry Talks extends far beyond a traditional informational conference. Bringing together over 200 high-level guests, it fosters a dynamic ecosystem for high-level networking. Here, you will connect with major industry players, initiate new strategic partnerships, and generate ideas that drive real business value. Complementing the intensive professional agenda, the full event program features premium standard coffee breaks, and an exclusive closing dinner.

Procurement Conference 2026

🚀 “Procurement Conference 2026” organized by “Easy Procurement”, will be held on November 11th,2026.



The 4th annual “Procurement Conference” will be held on a larger scale this year and will bring together Georgian and international experts, procurement and supply chain professionals, business owners, managers, and representatives of various industries in one place.



Why should you attend?

At the conference, you will gain:

REALTY FORUM TBILISI INVEST 2026

Capital. Investments. Strategies. Returns.

🗓️ November 17–19, 2026

📍 Pullman Tbilisi Axis Towers | Tbilisi, Georgia


REALTY FORUM TBILISI INVEST 2026 is an international forum dedicated to real estate, investments, capital management and wealth-building strategies.

This is not a forum about choosing a property. It is a forum about where to allocate capital, how to evaluate investment opportunities and how to build an effective investment strategy for the next 5 years.


The event brings together investors, developers, entrepreneurs, real estate professionals, investment advisors, fund representatives, bankers and business leaders to discuss where capital is moving, which markets will grow, what investment models generate sustainable returns and how real estate fits into a diversified portfolio.


Over three days, participants will gain practical insights into real estate investment, portfolio management, international markets, hospitality and wellness real estate, private capital, investment funds, risk management and emerging opportunities in Georgia and beyond.


Key Topics

- Where would top investors allocate $1,000,000 today?

- Real estate investment strategies for 2027–2031

- Building and managing an investment portfolio

- Hospitality Real Estate and Branded Residences

- Wellness Real Estate and future growth sectors

- Investment funds and collective real estate investments

- ROI, IRR, capitalization and real profitability calculations

- Capital growth vs cash flow strategies

- Private capital and family office investment approaches

- International capital flows and Georgia's role in the region

- Tbilisi as an emerging investment market

- Risk assessment, due diligence and exit strategies

- The future of real estate and capital allocation through 2031


Why Attend?

Learn directly from investors, developers, entrepreneurs and market leaders

Discover where capital is moving and which markets offer the strongest opportunities

Gain practical investment frameworks and portfolio strategies

Connect with investors, brokers, developers and decision-makers from multiple countries

Explore investment projects and opportunities in Georgia

Participate in exclusive networking sessions and business meetings

Join the Invest Tour and experience selected investment projects in Tbilisi firsthand


REALTY FORUM has become one of the leading international real estate platforms in Georgia, bringing together professionals, investors and industry leaders from dozens of countries. The forum serves as a hub where partnerships are built, projects are launched and investment opportunities are created.

Legal Tech Meetup 2026

Legal Tech Meetup 2026 is the largest legal technology conference in Eastern Europe and Central Asia.




Launched two years ago in partnership with the European Legal Technology Association (ELTA) as the first legal technology conference in the Caucasus region, Legal Tech Meetup returns to Tbilisi in November 2026 in an expanded two-day format.




The conference brings together the people shaping the future of legal work: law firm leaders, general counsel, legal operations professionals, technology-company representatives, and innovators.




Day 1 is designed for law firms, focusing on how business models are evolving in the AI era, how firms are building AI-powered legal practices, and what clients now expect from outside counsel.

Day 2 is designed for in-house legal teams, covering the implementation of AI within organisations, its safe and effective use, productivity, and the future of legal operations.

Legal Tech Meetup 2026 is a place to explore the most important industry trends and practical experience, discuss the challenges facing the profession, and connect with the people driving these changes.
